name: dreeft
description: Band above the prompt showing what the session's thinking is doing: focus, a turn timeline, and turn cost

palette.title: Timeline colors
palette.description: How thinking and tool cells are colored. mono uses brightness only; amber, blue and magenta color thinking (magenta also colors tools cyan).

memoryShadow.title: Memory shadow log (experimental)
memoryShadow.description: off or on. on: after each main-loop turn, pick candidate facts from the thinking, judge them with Haiku (one call per turn with candidates) and append the verdicts to ~/.local/state/dreeft/memory-shadow.jsonl. Never writes memory.

desktop.title: Band on the desktop app (experimental)
desktop.description: off or on. on: also draw the band in the Claude Code desktop app. Untested: nobody has checked how the band draws there. off draws on the terminal only. VS Code and mobile never get the band.

steer.title: Steering (experimental)
steer.description: off, shadow or on. Changes what the model reads. When a turn has grown the context by 10 points of the window, and again at 20, a coin flip picks fire or hold. shadow: every trigger holds; each is appended to ~/.local/state/dreeft/steer.jsonl and nothing is sent. on: a fire also appends one hidden two-sentence note to the conversation, which the model reads, and a visible notice of it; both arms are logged. off sends and writes nothing.
